reasoning: The flagged README.md instruction is documentation-only and never executed during PKGBUILD build/install. All executable components (PKGBUILD, Zig scripts) show no malicious behavior.
disagreement_analysis: qwen incorrectly treated README.md build instructions as executable threats, while deepseek correctly recognized them as non-executable documentation.
false_positives: README.md 'pip install' warning: Documentation-only file not executed during build/install
learnings: Improve context awareness: Train models to distinguish between build instructions in documentation vs. actual PKGBUILD execution paths
Prioritize executable artifacts: Weight PKGBUILD/.install files higher than documentation during file selection
Reduce false positives: Explicitly flag non-executable files (READMEs, docs) as low-risk unless referenced in PKGBUILD functions
